Sabarimala Temple Appoints New Chief Priest

The Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) has appointed Kandararu Brahmadathan as the new Sabarimala Tantri. The appointment is set to take effect from the beginning of the Malayalam month of Chingam 1. This decision marks a change in the temple's priestly leadership.
